en.title: Telling a story in the past
en.summary: A past story combines the simple past, the past continuous and the past perfect.

paragraphs: A story in the past uses the simple past for the main events, the past continuous for the background and the past perfect for what happened earlier.
Sequence words such as first, then, after that and finally help the reader to follow the events.
